entries.jp:
徳川家康が幕府を築き
世を平定してから
二百余年――
長きに渡る安寧の世が
続いている
entries.en:
Over two
centuries after
Ieyasu Tokugawa
founded the
shogunate and
brought peace, a
long era of calm
went on.

entries.jp:
若くして彦根藩の家督を
継いだその男は　有り余る
才覚を以て頭角を現し
大志を抱いて江戸へと上った
entries.en:
A man who
became lord of
Hikone while
young rose on
his abundant
talent, and went
up to Edo with
great ambitions.

entries.jp:
江戸へと上り――
そして
僅か一年ばかりの間に
絶望の淵へと
追いやられていた
entries.en:
He went up to
Edo-- and then,
in barely a year,
he had been
driven to the
brink of despair.

entries.jp: どうして私の案が\n取り入れられない\nのですか！
entries.en: Why is my\nproposal not\nbeing adopted!?

entries.jp: 江戸幕府の溜詰筆頭である侍\n井伊直弼は　物怖じもせずに\n目の前の老人たちへと迫った
entries.en:
Naosuke Ii,
head of the Edo
shogunate's
Inner Council
lords, fearlessly
pressed the old
men before him.

entries.jp: 井伊殿の案？\nさて　何だったか……
entries.en:
Ii-dono's
proposal?
Now, what
was it again...

entries.jp: とぼけるのは\nやめていただきたい
entries.en: Kindly stop\nplaying dumb.

entries.jp: 先日提案した\n治水工事の提案書です
entries.en:
The flood-control
proposal I
submitted the
other day.

entries.jp: おお　その件か\nもちろん　老中の間で\n検討したぞ
entries.en:
Ah, that matter.
Of course we
Elders gave it our
consideration.

entries.jp: さすがは天才と\n呼ばれることはある
entries.en: Truly worthy\nof one they\ncall a genius.

entries.jp: まさに水も漏らさぬ\n完璧な提案書であった
entries.en:
It was a perfect
proposal.
Watertight, one
might say.

entries.jp: そうです\nあの計画書は完璧\nだったはず
entries.en: Exactly. That\nplan should have\nbeen flawless.

entries.jp: ならばどうして――
entries.en: Then why--

entries.jp: 老中たちが　口元を隠して\n漏らす笑いには　明らかな\n嘲りの色が含まれている
entries.en:
The laughter the
Elders let slip
behind their
hands was plainly
tinged with scorn.

entries.jp: 笑い声が聞こえた方に\n井伊が視線を向けると\n老中たちはぴたりと黙った
entries.en:
When Ii turned
his gaze toward
the laughter,
the Elders fell
abruptly silent.

entries.jp: 首座殿
entries.en: Chief Elder.

entries.jp: 老中筆頭の貴殿から\n納得のいく理由を\nお聞かせ願いたい
entries.en:
As head of the
Elders, I would
ask you to give
me a reason I
can accept.

entries.jp: やれやれ……\n面倒なことだ
entries.en: Good grief...\nWhat a bother.

entries.jp: よく聞け\n一度しか言わぬ
entries.en: Listen well. I shall\nsay this only once.

entries.jp: 完璧だったから\n却下されたのだ
entries.en: It was rejected\nbecause it was\nperfect.

entries.jp: そんな説明では\n納得できません！
entries.en: I cannot accept\nan explanation\nlike that!

entries.jp: 井伊殿\n徳川の世は安定しておる\nわしらのおかげでな
entries.en:
Ii-dono, the
Tokugawa realm
is stable. Thanks
to us old men,
mind you.

entries.jp: 何も変える必要はない\n何も変えてはいけない\nそれがわからんか？
entries.en:
Nothing needs to
change. Nothing
must change.
Can you not
understand that?

entries.jp: それは違います\nご老中
entries.en: That is wrong,\nmy lord Elder.

entries.jp: 違わぬのだよ\n分からぬのなら\n仕方あるまい
entries.en:
It is not wrong.
If you cannot
understand, it
cannot be helped.

entries.jp: 井伊直弼\n貴殿の任を解く
entries.en: Naosuke Ii. You\nare relieved of\nyour post.

entries.jp: ……なんですと？
entries.en: ...I beg your\npardon?

entries.jp: 今後　幕府の政策に\n口を挟むこと\n一切　罷りならん
entries.en:
Henceforth, you
are forbidden to
meddle in
shogunate
policy in any
way whatsoever.

entries.jp: しばらく登城する\n必要もないぞ
entries.en:
Nor is there any
need for you to
attend the castle
for some time.

entries.jp: 話はそれだけだ
entries.en: That is all.

entries.jp: ご老中！
entries.en: My lord Elder!

entries.jp: 老中たちが去っていった\nふすまの向こうから\n嘲笑の声が響いて聞こえた
entries.en:
From beyond the
sliding doors the
Elders had left
through,
mocking laughter
echoed back.

entries.jp: 変化を恐れ　利権に\nしがみつく老害どもめ
entries.en:
Old relics,
afraid of change
and clinging to
their privileges.

entries.jp: 進歩と改善の余地は\nいくらでもあると\n言うのに……
entries.en:
When there is
endless room for
progress and
improvement...

entries.jp: いずれ正しいのは\n私だということを\n世の中が思い知る
entries.en: One day the\nworld will learn\nthat I was right.

entries.jp: しかし――
entries.en: However--

entries.jp:
それは　あの老人たちが
死に絶えるまで　井伊に
順番が回ってこないという
意味でもあった
entries.en:
That also meant
Ii's turn would
not come until
those old men
had all died off.

entries.jp: 胸中の想いを吐き出すと\n井伊は空を見上げた
entries.en:
Having vented
the feelings in his
heart, Ii looked
up at the sky.

entries.jp: その瞬間　奇妙な光景が\n視界に飛び込んできた
entries.en: At that moment,\na strange sight\nleapt into view.

entries.jp: あわわっ！
entries.en: Waaah!

entries.jp: なにっ
entries.en: What!?

entries.jp: 内郭の庭に建てられた御殿の\n三階の窓縁から　今まさに\n人影が落ちようとしていた
entries.en:
From the
third-floor
window ledge of
a palace built in
the inner
garden, a figure
was about to fall.

entries.jp: いかんっ
entries.en: No!

entries.jp: 井伊が地を蹴って\n落下地点へと走り込む
entries.en:
Ii kicked off the
ground and
dashed to where
the figure
would land.

entries.jp: あの高さからだ\n受け止めきれるか？\nいや――
entries.en: From that\nheight... can I\ncatch it? No--

entries.jp: 冷静な思考よりも\n体が先に動いていた
entries.en: His body moved\nbefore cool\nthought could.

entries.jp: 井伊が衝撃に備えて\n腰を落とし全身に力を\n込める
entries.en:
Ii braced for the
impact, lowering
his stance and
tensing every
muscle in his
body.

entries.jp: むうっ
entries.en: Nngh!

entries.jp:
しかし
予想していた
衝撃は伝わって
こなかった
entries.en: But the impact\nhe had expected\nnever came.

entries.jp: な　なんだ\nこれは……？
entries.en: Wh-what...\nis this...?

entries.jp:
落ちてきた人物は
井伊の腕の中で
淡い光に包まれながら
ふわふわと浮いている
entries.en:
The falling
figure floated
softly in Ii's
arms, wrapped
in a faint light.

entries.jp: 子供？\n男の子……か？\nおっと！
entries.en: A child? A\nboy...? Whoa!

entries.jp:
不意に少年の身体を
包んでいた淡い光が消え
井伊の腕にずしりと
重みが伝わってきた
entries.en:
Suddenly the
faint light around
the boy's body
vanished, and his
full weight
settled heavily
into Ii's arms.

entries.jp: またか……
entries.en: Not again...

entries.jp: 大丈夫か？\n怪我はないか？
entries.en: Are you all right?\nAre you hurt?

entries.jp: あ　うん\n予は大丈夫だよ\nどこも痛くない
entries.en: Oh, yeah. I'm fine.\nNothing hurts.

entries.jp: そうか\n良かった
entries.en: I see. Good.

entries.jp: お前が助けてくれたの？
entries.en: Did you save me?

entries.jp: そうだ\nいや　どうだろう
entries.en: I did. Well...\nperhaps not.

entries.jp: 私が助けなくても\n地面に激突することは\nなかったかも――
entries.en:
Even if I hadn't
caught you, you
might never have
hit the ground--

entries.jp: ねえ\n名前を教えてよ
entries.en: Hey, tell me\nyour name.

entries.jp: 私の名前か？\n井伊直弼という
entries.en: My name? It\nis Naosuke Ii.

entries.jp: そうか\nありがとう直弼
entries.en: I see. Thank\nyou, Naosuke.

entries.jp: う　いや　その\n無事でよかった
entries.en: Ah, well, er... I'm\nglad you're safe.

entries.jp: 少年が浮かべている\n春の陽ざしのような笑顔に\n井伊は目を細めて笑い返す
entries.en:
At the boy's smile,
like warm spring
sunshine, Ii
narrowed his eyes
and smiled back.

entries.jp:
張り詰めた江戸での生活の
中で　思い返せば
前に笑ったのがいつだった
のかすら　井伊は
思い出せなくなっていた
entries.en:
In his tense
life in Edo, Ii
could no longer
even remember
the last time he
had smiled.

entries.jp: あっ　そうだ\n人に名前を尋ねる時は\n自分から名乗るんだった
entries.en:
Oh, right! When
you ask someone's
name, you're
supposed to give
your own first.

entries.jp: 予は一橋慶喜という\nよろしくね　直弼
entries.en:
I'm Yoshinobu
Hitotsubashi.
Nice to meet
you, Naosuke.

entries.jp: 井伊の腕の中で\n少年がにっこりと微笑んだ
entries.en: In Ii's arms,\nthe boy\nbeamed at him.

entries.jp: それが一橋慶喜――
entries.en: That was how\nYoshinobu\nHitotsubashi--

entries.jp: 後の第十五代将軍\n徳川慶喜と井伊直弼の\n出会いであった
entries.en:
--the future
fifteenth shogun,
Yoshinobu
Tokugawa--first
met Naosuke Ii.

entries.jp: その日を境に　井伊は\nたびたび慶喜の下へ\n訪れるようになった
entries.en: From that day on,\nIi began to visit\nYoshinobu often.

entries.jp: それは　江戸城内にある\n薄暗い一室だった
entries.en: It was a dim room\ninside Edo Castle.

entries.jp: ここにずっと\nおられるのですか\nおひとりで……
entries.en: You have been\nhere all this time?\nAll by yourself...

entries.jp: ごはんはきちんと\nもらえるからね
entries.en: They make sure\nI get my meals.

entries.jp: 不便はないよ\n皆には感謝している
entries.en:
So I don't want
for anything.
I'm grateful to
everyone.

entries.jp: それに　最近は\n直弼が来てくれるから\n寂しくないんだ
entries.en:
Besides, lately
you've been
coming to see
me, Naosuke, so
I'm not lonely.

entries.jp: 慶喜様\nひとつお聞きしても\nよろしいですか？
entries.en: Yoshinobu-sama,\nmay I ask you\nsomething?

entries.jp: なに？
entries.en: What is it?

entries.jp: 私が慶喜様を助けた時\nまたか　と申されました\nどういう意味でしょう
entries.en:
When I saved
you,
Yoshinobu-sama,
you said "not
again." What
did you mean?

entries.jp: ああ\n予はよくああいう目に\n遭うんだ　だから
entries.en: Oh, that. Things\nlike that happen\nto me a lot. So...

entries.jp: ああいう目\nとは？
entries.en: Things like that?

entries.jp: 高いところから落ちたり\n重いものが落ちてきたり\n階段を踏み外したり
entries.en:
Falling from
high places,
heavy things
falling on me,
missing a step
on the stairs...

entries.jp: この間は\n露台（バルコニー）が\nたまたま腐っていたみたい
entries.en:
The other day, it
seems the balcony
just happened to
be rotten.

entries.jp: たまたま？
entries.en: Happened to be?

entries.jp: そう　たまたま\n予は運が悪いのかな\nあはは
entries.en:
Yeah, it just
happened. I
guess I'm
unlucky. Ahaha.

entries.jp: 露台には　よく\n行かれるのですか？
entries.en: Do you go out\non the balcony\noften?

entries.jp: うん\n歌を歌おうと思って
entries.en: Yeah. To\nsing songs.

entries.jp: 歌\nですか
entries.en: Singing, you say?

entries.jp: 青空の下で歌うと\nとても気持ちがいいんだ
entries.en: Singing under\nthe blue sky\nfeels really nice.

entries.jp: そうだ！\n直弼にも聴かせてあげる！
entries.en: I know! I'll\nsing for you\ntoo, Naosuke!

entries.jp:
慶喜はすっくと
立ち上がると
胸に手を当てて
静かに歌い始めた
entries.en:
Yoshinobu stood
up straight, laid
a hand on his
chest, and quietly
began to sing.

entries.jp: 慶喜の歌声が響き\n仄暗い部屋の中を\n満たしていく
entries.en: Yoshinobu's voice\nrang out, filling\nthe dim room.

entries.jp: それは慶喜の笑顔と同じ\nやわらかな陽の光のように\n井伊を優しく包んだ
entries.en:
Like soft
sunlight, just
like Yoshinobu's
smile, it wrapped
gently around Ii.

entries.jp: なんと……\n素晴らしい……
entries.en: How...\nwonderful...

entries.jp: そう呟きながら\n井伊は自分の頬に伝う\n涙に気付く
entries.en:
Murmuring this,
Ii noticed the
tears running
down his cheeks.

entries.jp: 私は　まだこのような\n暖かい涙を流すことが\nできたのか……
entries.en: Can I still shed\ntears as warm\nas these...?

entries.jp: この時　井伊は\nはっきりと自覚した
entries.en: In that moment,\nIi knew it clearly:

entries.jp: 暇潰しや同情などではなく\n自分は慶喜という存在に\n惹かれているのだと
entries.en:
not to pass
the time, nor
out of pity--
he was drawn
to Yoshinobu
himself.

entries.jp: どうだった？
entries.en: How was it?

entries.jp: あんまり上手じゃないけど\n直弼のことを思って\n歌ったんだ
entries.en:
I'm not very
good, but I sang
it thinking of
you, Naosuke.

entries.jp: ありがとうございます\nこの直弼\n感服いたしました
entries.en: Thank you. I,\nNaosuke, am\ndeeply moved.

entries.jp: えっ　そんな\nほめ過ぎだよ\n照れくさいな
entries.en:
Huh? Oh, come
on, you're
praising me
too much. It's
embarrassing.

entries.jp: いえ\nそんなことはありません\n心に染み入りました
entries.en: No, not at all.\nIt touched my\nvery heart.

entries.jp: それは本心からの\n言葉だった
entries.en:
Those words
came from
the bottom
of his heart.

entries.jp: 井伊は見つけたのだ\n己が信じられる存在を――
entries.en: Ii had found it:\nsomeone he\ncould believe in--

entries.jp: 翌日　井伊は再び\n老中たちの下を訪れた
entries.en: The next day, Ii\nonce again called\non the Elders.

entries.jp: 登城の必要はないと\n申し付けたはずだが
entries.en:
I believe I told
you there was no
need to attend
the castle.

entries.jp: そのことでお願いがあり\n参上仕りました
entries.en:
I have come
because I have
a request
regarding that
very matter.

entries.jp: 願い？\n溜詰への復職か？\n話にもならん
entries.en:
A request? To
be reinstated
on the Inner
Council? Out of
the question.

entries.jp: いえ　一橋慶喜様の\n世話役を賜りたく
entries.en:
No. I wish to
be appointed
caretaker to
Yoshinobu-sama
of the
Hitotsubashi
house.

entries.jp: 一橋慶喜だと？
entries.en: Yoshinobu\nHitotsubashi,\nyou say?

entries.jp: 老中は　ねっとりとした\n視線で　頭を垂れている\n井伊を眺めまわす
entries.en:
The Elder looked
the bowing Ii up
and down with a
slimy gaze.

entries.jp:
しばらく
重い沈黙が続いたが
畳に頭を擦り付け続ける
井伊の姿に見飽きたのか
やがて首座が口を開いた
entries.en:
A heavy silence
went on for some
time, but at last--
perhaps tired of
watching Ii keep
his head pressed
to the tatami--the
Chief Elder spoke.

entries.jp: ……よかろう
entries.en: ...Very well.

entries.jp: ありがとうございます
entries.en: Thank you.

entries.jp:
井伊は手短に
そう答えると
踵を返して
部屋を出ていった
entries.en:
Ii answered
briefly, turned
on his heel, and
left the room.

entries.jp: あの若造\n何を考えているのやら……
entries.en: That whelp.\nWhat could he\nbe thinking...

entries.jp: 役目を取り上げられて\n日和ったか　ほほほほ
entries.en: Stripped of his\npost, he's lost his\nnerve. Ohohoho.

entries.jp: 私は　正直安堵しておる\n井伊が私たちを見る目は\nぞっとしなかった
entries.en:
Frankly, I am
relieved. The
way Ii looked at
us gave me chills.

entries.jp: 確かに慶喜は将軍家の\n直系だが　あのガキに\nついても得はあるまい
entries.en:
True, Yoshinobu
is of the shogun's
direct line, but
there's nothing
to gain by siding
with that brat.

entries.jp: すでに一橋派には何の\n力もないのは　誰の目\nにも明白であろうに
entries.en:
It is plain to
anyone that the
Hitotsubashi
faction has no
power left at all.

entries.jp: 首座殿の\nおっしゃる通りです
entries.en: Just as you say,\nChief Elder.

entries.jp: 何にせよ　慶喜に世話役が\n必要なのも　あとわずかで\nしかないがな
entries.en:
In any case,
Yoshinobu won't
be needing a
caretaker for
much longer.

entries.jp: それまで　落ちぶれた者\n同士で　傷のなめ合いでも\nしているがいいわ
entries.en:
Until then, let the
two has-beens
lick each other's
wounds.

entries.jp: くっくっくっ……
entries.en: Heh heh heh...

entries.jp: 慶喜の世話役に就いた\n井伊は　日々その役目を\n不足なくこなした
entries.en:
Appointed
Yoshinobu's
caretaker, Ii
carried out
his duties
without fault
day after day.

entries.jp:
慶喜との穏やかな暮らしに
かつて抱いていた
野心は消え　いつしか
井伊も笑みを浮かべる
ようになっていた
entries.en:
In his peaceful
life with
Yoshinobu, the
ambition he once
held faded away,
and before he
knew it, Ii too had
begun to smile.

entries.jp: 全ての権限を\n取り上げられた慶喜に\n浮かぶ目はないだろう
entries.en:
Stripped of
all authority,
Yoshinobu
had no hope
of ever rising.

entries.jp: それでもいいと\n井伊は思った\n慶喜といられるのなら
entries.en:
Even so, Ii
thought that was
fine--as long as
he could be with
Yoshinobu.

entries.jp: そんな\nある日のことだった
entries.en: And then,\none day...

entries.jp: おはよう　直弼\nねえ　この箱\n開けてもいいかな？
entries.en: Good morning,\nNaosuke! Hey, can\nI open this box?

entries.jp:
慶喜は　漆塗りの箱を
抱えながら　井伊の下へ
駆け寄ると　嬉しそうな
声で　そう訊いた
entries.en:
Clutching a
lacquered box,
Yoshinobu ran up
to Ii and asked
him happily.

entries.jp: 箱？\nなんですか？\nそれは
entries.en: A box? What\nis that?

entries.jp: えっ\n直弼からの贈り物じゃ\nないの？
entries.en: Huh? Isn't it a\npresent from\nyou, Naosuke?

entries.jp: 届けてくれた者が\nそう言っていたけど……
entries.en: That's what the\nperson who\nbrought it said...

entries.jp: いえ　私はそのような\n物など　贈った覚えは――
entries.en: No, I don't recall\nsending anything\nof the sort--

entries.jp: 井伊の言葉を待たずに\n慶喜が箱に掛けられた\n紐を解こうとした
entries.en:
Before Ii could
finish,
Yoshinobu began
to untie the cord
around the box.

entries.jp: その瞬間　井伊の鼻を\n焦げ臭い空気が掠めた
entries.en: At that instant, a\nburning smell\nbrushed Ii's nose.

entries.jp: 慶喜様\n離れて
entries.en: Yoshinobu-sama,\nget back!

entries.jp: あっ！
entries.en: Ah!

entries.jp:
井伊は
漆塗りの箱を奪うと
慶喜から距離を取るように
部屋の端へと走った
entries.en:
Ii snatched the
lacquered box
and ran to the
far corner of
the room, away
from Yoshinobu.

entries.jp: その瞬間――
entries.en: At that moment--

entries.jp: 強烈な衝撃と共に\n箱がはじけ灼熱の炎が\n井伊の全身を包む
entries.en:
With a
tremendous blast,
the box burst
open, and searing
flames engulfed
Ii's whole body.

entries.jp: ぐぉぉおおおっ
entries.en: Gwaaaaaagh!

entries.jp: 直弼
entries.en: Naosuke!

entries.jp: 近づいてはなりません
entries.en: Do not come near!

entries.jp: でも\nでも
entries.en: But... but...

entries.jp: 井伊は壁に体を叩きつけ\n着物に移った炎を消す
entries.en:
Ii threw himself
against the wall
to smother the
flames on his
kimono.

entries.jp: 火は……消えました\n直弼はこの通り\n平気です……ぐうっ
entries.en:
The fire... is out.
As you can see,
Naosuke is quite
all right... ngh!

entries.jp: 焼け焦げた半身のまま\n慶喜に向かって両手を広げ\n井伊は微笑んで見せる
entries.en:
Half his body
scorched, Ii
spread his
arms toward
Yoshinobu and
smiled for him.

entries.jp: それより　ごふっ……\n慶喜様にお怪我は\nありませんでしたか？
entries.en:
More
importantly--
*cough*... Are
you hurt,
Yoshinobu-sama?

entries.jp: 予は平気だよ！\nでも　直弼が　直弼が
entries.en: I'm fine! But\nNaosuke, you're...

entries.jp: そうですか……\nご無事でよかった\n本当に……良かった……
entries.en: I see... I'm glad\nyou're safe.\nTruly... so glad...

entries.jp: 直弼ーっ
entries.en: Naosukeee!

entries.jp: 薄れ行く意識の中\n悲痛な慶喜の声だけが\nどこか遠くで響いていた
entries.en:
As his
consciousness
faded, only
Yoshinobu's
anguished
voice echoed
somewhere
far away.

entries.jp: 気が付けば　井伊は\n見渡す限りの闇の中にいた
entries.en:
When he came to,
Ii was surrounded
by darkness as
far as the eye
could see.

entries.jp: ここはどこだ？
entries.en: Where am I?

entries.jp: 私は――そうだ\n慶喜様をかばって\n倒れたのか
entries.en:
I... Yes. I
collapsed
shielding
Yoshinobu-sama.

entries.jp: 我は死んだのか？
entries.en: Am I dead?

entries.jp: ……命が惜しいか？
entries.en: ...Do you cling\nto your life?

entries.jp: 誰だ
entries.en: Who's there?

entries.jp: 命が惜しいか？
entries.en: Do you cling\nto your life?

entries.jp: 己の命など\n惜しくはない
entries.en: My own life\nmeans\nnothing to me.

entries.jp: ほう……
ただ　ひとつだけ\n慶喜様のことが\n気がかりだ
entries.en:
There is only
one thing that
weighs on me:
Yoshinobu-sama.

entries.jp: あの方は　これまでも\n命を狙われ続けてきた
entries.en: His life has\nbeen targeted\nagain and again.

entries.jp: ただ将軍家の血筋に\n生まれたというだけで
entries.en:
Simply for
being born into
the shogun's
bloodline.

entries.jp: そんなつまらない理由で\n殺されるのか
entries.en: Is he to be\nkilled for so\npetty a reason?

entries.jp: それが　あの者の宿命よ
entries.en: Such is his fate.

entries.jp: 将軍に選ばれなければ\n存在そのものが\n世を乱す
entries.en:
Unless he is
chosen as shogun,
his very existence
throws the world
into disorder.

entries.jp: 宿命など知るか！
entries.en: To hell with fate!

entries.jp: 誰から疎まれようと\nどんな仕打ちを受けても\nあの方は微笑んでいた
entries.en:
No matter who
shunned him, no
matter how he
was treated, he
kept on smiling.

entries.jp: ただ　それだけだ！
entries.en: That is all\nhe ever did!

entries.jp: 誰も　誰一人として\nあの方の想いを汚す\n権利などないのに！
entries.en:
No one--not a
single soul--
has the right to
sully his heart!

entries.jp: あの者が生きるには\n将軍となる他\n道はない
entries.en:
For him to live,
there is no
path but to
become shogun.

entries.jp: そして　あの者には\nそれに適う力がない
entries.en: And he lacks\nthe power for it.

entries.jp: 死すべきは宿命――
entries.en: His fate is to die--

entries.jp: 黙れ\nそれが天意であっても\n我は認めない！
entries.en:
Silence! Even if
it is the will of
Heaven, I will
not accept it!

entries.jp: 我だけはっ……
entries.en: I alone will not...!

entries.jp: そうか　ならば\n試させてもらおう
entries.en: I see. Then let me\nput it to the test--

entries.jp: お前の信じる\n想いとやらを
entries.en: --these feelings\nyou believe in.

entries.jp: な　なんだ？\nぬうっ……！
entries.en: Wh-what...?\nNngh...!

entries.jp: 突然　体が重くなり\n耐え切れずに井伊は\n地に膝をつく
entries.en:
Suddenly his
body grew heavy,
and unable to
bear it, Ii sank to
his knees.

entries.jp: 視界を覆う闇が渦巻き\n身体の端々から井伊の\n中へと染み込んできた
entries.en:
The darkness
filling his vision
swirled and
seeped into Ii
from every part
of his body.

entries.jp: やめろ……！\n我は　まだ死ぬわけには\nいかないのだ！
entries.en: Stop...! I\ncannot die yet!

entries.jp: あの方を　慶喜様を\nお護りしなければ……
entries.en: I must\nprotect him...\nYoshinobu-sama...

entries.jp: 混濁する意識の中\nどこからか　慶喜の\n歌声が聴こえる気がした
entries.en:
Through the
haze in his mind,
he thought he
heard Yoshinobu
singing from
somewhere.

entries.jp: 慶喜様……
entries.en: Yoshinobu-sama...

entries.jp: そうして井伊直弼は\n闇に呑み込まれた
entries.en: And so Naosuke\nIi was swallowed\nby the darkness.

entries.jp: よしのぶ……さま……
entries.en: Yoshi...\nnobu... sama...

entries.jp: 直弼\n意識が戻ったんだね！
entries.en: Naosuke!\nYou're awake!

entries.jp: 慶喜様……\nここは？\n私はどうして
entries.en: Yoshinobu-sama...\nWhere am I?\nWhy am I...

entries.jp: 直弼は　あれから三日も\n眠ったままだったんだ
entries.en:
You've been
asleep for three
whole days since
then, Naosuke.

entries.jp: 医者も　このまま意識が\n戻らなければ\n助からないだろうって
entries.en:
The doctor said
that if you didn't
wake up soon,
you wouldn't
make it.

entries.jp: でも良かった\n予の歌が天に届いたのかも\n知れない
entries.en:
But I'm so glad.
Maybe my song
reached the
heavens.

entries.jp: 慶喜様の歌……
entries.en: Your song,\nYoshinobu-sama...

entries.jp: 気付けば\n井伊の身体が\n淡い光に包まれていた
entries.en:
Only then did Ii
notice his body
was wrapped in
a faint light.

entries.jp: 私のために　歌い続けて\nくださったのですか……\n三日三晩も……
entries.en:
You kept singing
for me...? For
three days and
three nights...

entries.jp: 直弼のためなら\n一か月だって　一年だって\n歌い続けるつもりだった
entries.en:
For you,
Naosuke, I'd have
kept singing for
a month, even a
year.

entries.jp: でも　よかった
entries.en: But I'm so glad.

entries.jp: 予が生きていてもいいと\n言ってくれるのは\n直弼だけだもの……
entries.en:
You're the only
one who tells
me it's all right
for me to be
alive, Naosuke...

entries.jp: 慶喜の目から\n大粒の涙が零れ落ちる
entries.en: Big tears spilled\nfrom Yoshinobu's\neyes.

entries.jp: 慶喜様
entries.en: Yoshinobu-sama...

entries.jp: 井伊は　そんな慶喜を\nそっと　しかし力強く\n抱き締めた
entries.en:
Ii held
Yoshinobu close,
gently, yet with
all his strength.

entries.jp: 直弼\nずっと予のそばに\nいてくれるよね？
entries.en:
Naosuke... You'll
stay by my side
forever, won't
you?

entries.jp: 約束しましょう\nこの命に代えて　直弼は\n慶喜様をお護りします
entries.en:
I promise. On
my life, Naosuke
will protect you,
Yoshinobu-sama.

entries.jp: どんなことをしてでも\nどんな代償を支払って\nでも――
entries.en: Whatever I must\ndo, whatever\nprice I must pay--

entries.jp: 慶喜の暗殺未遂事件から\n数週間後――
entries.en: A few weeks after\nthe attempt on\nYoshinobu's life--

entries.jp: 井伊は　老中たちを集め\n会議の場を用意した
entries.en:
Ii gathered
the Elders
and arranged
a meeting.

entries.jp: 一橋慶喜が継承権を\n放棄するという話\n真であろうな？
entries.en:
This talk of
Yoshinobu
Hitotsubashi
giving up his
right of
succession. It
is true, I trust?

entries.jp: そのために　皆様に\nお集まりいただいたのです
entries.en: That is why I\nhave asked you\nall to gather here.

entries.jp: ふむ……
entries.en: Hmm...

entries.jp: 老中首座は\n片方の眉を歪めて\n井伊の顔を仰ぎ見た
entries.en:
The Chief
Elder raised
one eyebrow
and looked up
into Ii's face.

entries.jp: その眼帯はどうしたのだ\n先の爆弾騒ぎの時に\n傷を負ったか？
entries.en:
What happened
with that
eyepatch? Were
you hurt in
that business
with the bomb?

entries.jp: 代償……\nでございますよ
entries.en: It is... the\nprice I paid.

entries.jp: 代償？\nまったくその通り
entries.en: The price?\nQuite so.

entries.jp: 若造めが\nようやく身の程を\n思い知ったようだ
entries.en:
The whelp has
finally learned
his place, it
seems.

entries.jp:
老中たちが全員
集まったのを確認すると
井伊は立ち上がり
広間の端まで通る声で
儀式の開始を宣言した
entries.en:
Once he saw that
all the Elders had
gathered, Ii rose
and, in a voice
that carried to
the far end of the
hall, declared the
ceremony begun.

entries.jp: まずは　慶喜様から皆様に\nひとつ歌をご披露したいと\n仰られております
entries.en:
First,
Yoshinobu-sama
wishes to perform
a song for you all.

entries.jp: 歌？\n歌などと……
entries.en: A song? Of all\nthe frivolous...

entries.jp: 何事にも段取りが\nあるのですよ
entries.en: Everything has\nits proper order.

entries.jp: まずは慶喜様の歌を\n聴いて頂かなければ
entries.en:
First, you
must listen to
Yoshinobu-sama's
song.

entries.jp:
有無を言わさぬ井伊の
圧力に　老中は歌くらい
ならと浮かせかけた腰を
落ち着けた
entries.en:
The Elders had
half risen, but
under Ii's
unyielding
pressure they sat
back down. Surely
a song could do
no harm.

entries.jp: 命惜しさに　名目でしか\nなかった継承権まで\n差し出すとは　哀れな
entries.en:
Handing over
even his claim to
succession,
empty as it was,
to save his own
skin. How pitiful.

entries.jp: 形だけとはいえ継承権は\n慶喜が生かされる唯一の\n理由であった
entries.en:
Though a mere
formality, that
claim to
succession had
been the only
reason Yoshinobu
was kept alive.

entries.jp: あの　直弼\n予は……
entries.en: Um, Naosuke... I...

entries.jp: 慶喜は　井伊の袴の裾を\n掴んだまま　不安げに\n広間を見渡した
entries.en:
Still clutching
the hem of Ii's
hakama,
Yoshinobu
looked anxiously
around the hall.

entries.jp: 何の心配も\nいりません
entries.en: There is nothing\nto worry about.

entries.jp: 私が教えた歌を\nただ歌いさえすれば\n良いのです
entries.en: You need only\nsing the song\nI taught you.

entries.jp: できますね？
entries.en: You can do\nthat, can't you?

entries.jp: う　うん……\nじゃあ――
entries.en: O-okay... Then--

entries.jp: 心して聴くがよい
entries.en: Listen, and\ntake heed.

entries.jp: これこそが\n神君より受け継ぎし力！
entries.en:
This is the
power handed
down from our
divine founder!

entries.jp: 真の泰平へと導く歌！\n天歌
entries.en:
The song that
leads to true
peace!
Heaven's Song!
